title: ananassa porteana
intro: Ananassa porteana, commonly known as the Pineapple Guava, is a flowering plant species native to South America. The health benefits of Ananassa porteana include its high antioxidant content, which helps protect against cell damage and inflammation, and its potential anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use in treating digestive issues, such as constipation and diarrhea, and its potential use as a natural remedy for wounds and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of Ananassa porteana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
